title: Dayflow: free Rize alternative
caption:
Rize charges $12.99/month. Dayflow tracks where your day goes for free ⏱

✅ Turns your screen activity into a timeline of your day
✅ No timers, no manual notes
✅ Daily standup: yesterday's highlights, today's tasks
✅ Weekly review of focus and app usage, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Needs macOS 14+ and an AI to write the timeline: free local models, or your own Gemini/ChatGPT/Claude. An optional paid Pro plan does the AI setup for you

Comment "TIME" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #macos #macbook #productivity #timetracking #freeapps #techtips
